depends_on.name: spatial_gene_expression_pyramid_id
depends_on.documentation: The pyramid this cell segmentation was computed for.

depends_on.name: subject_id
depends_on.documentation: The subject (specimen) this segmentation is about.

depends_on.name: source_file_id
depends_on.documentation: The external source file (e.g. h5ad) the cell data was imported from, if any.

file.name: cells.tsv
file.documentation: One row per cell (centroid + per-gene counts).

file.name: contours.bin
file.documentation: The polygon vertices of each cell (only when contours_present is 1).

fields.name: label
fields.documentation: A human-readable label for this segmentation (e.g. 'SAW cellbin adjusted').

fields.name: n_cells
fields.documentation: The number of data rows in cells.tsv.

fields.name: segmentation_method
fields.documentation: How cells were segmented (e.g. 'SAW v7.1.2 CellBin', 'Cellpose 2.0').

fields.name: segmentation_dilation
fields.documentation: The radial expansion applied to each segmented nucleus, in coordinate_units. 0 if none.

fields.name: coordinate_units
fields.documentation: The units of the centroid and contour coordinates. SOURCE coordinate units, the same frame as the pyramid's origin_x and origin_y, NOT micrometers unless stated.

fields.name: contours_present
fields.documentation: 1 if contours.bin was written, 0 if only centroids are available.

fields.name: contour_reference
fields.documentation: Whether contour vertices are stored relative to their cell centroid ('centroid') or in absolute source coordinates ('absolute').

fields.name: n_vertices_per_cell
fields.documentation: 0 means contours are ragged and contours.bin carries an offset array. A positive value means every cell has exactly that many vertices and no offset array is present.

fields.name: data_type_vertex
fields.documentation: Integer type of the contour vertex arrays.

fields.name: data_type_offset
fields.documentation: Integer type of the contour offset array.

fields.name: contour_format_version
fields.documentation: The version of the contour binary layout.
